# Albato

> AI-driven no-code integration platform (iPaaS) connecting 1,000+ apps with automated workflows, embedded white-label solutions, and enterprise-grade security.

Albato provides both direct automation services and Albato Embedded, a white-label iPaaS for SaaS platforms. The platform emphasizes GDPR compliance, data protection, and AI-powered workflow automation with support for 320,000+ integrations across CRM, ESP, sales automation, and business tools.

## Key Topics

- Albato Embedded
- iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service)
- No-code automation
- White-label integrations
- GDPR compliance
- Data protection and security
- SaaS integrations
- Workflow automation
- API connections
- AI-driven automation
- Sales automation
- CRM integrations
- Zapier alternative
- Schrems II compliance
- International data transfers

- [Albato Pricing – Free to Enterprise Plans with AI Automation](https://albato.com/pricing): Pricing plans from Free to Enterprise with AI automation features
- [Integrate 1,000+ available apps with no code | Albato](https://albato.com/apps): App directory with 1,000+ integrations and 170,000+ ready scenarios
- [Explore 320,000+ Integrations | Connect Your Apps | Albato](https://albato.com/apps/all-integrations): Complete integrations marketplace with 320,000+ app connections

## Albato Embedded (White-Label iPaaS)

- [Albato Embedded AI-fueled Integration Platform for SaaS](https://albato.com/embedded): White-label embedded iPaaS for SaaS platforms to boost MRR and retention
- [Albato Embedded Success Stories](https://albato.com/embedded/success-stories): Customer success stories featuring RD Station, Loja Integrada, and others
- [#1 White-label iPaaS for Sales Automation SaaS](https://albato.com/embedded/sales-automation): Embedded iPaaS for CRM, ESP, and sales automation tool integrations
- [Albato AI-first Embedded iPaaS vs. Workato | Best Workato Alternative](https://albato.com/embedded/albato-vs-workato): Comparison showing Albato Embedded advantages over Workato iPaaS
